description: PP-A* finds a small set of paths that covers the Pareto set of a two-objective problem within a factor `1 + ε` in each objective. It searches over *path pairs*: two paths to one state, one with the smallest first cost and one with the smallest second cost. The *apex* of a pair, made of these two smallest costs, is a lower bound for all paths that the pair stands for. A new pair merges into an open pair at the same state when the merged pair stays within the tolerance, so near-equal paths share one entry. With `ε = 0` it returns the same costs as BOA*; it needs a consistent heuristic.

papers.title: Approximate Bi-Criteria Search by Efficient Representation of Subsets of the Pareto-Optimal Frontier
papers.venue: International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS)

lineage.source: multiobjective-search, src/pp_a.rs: "The search is BOA* over path pairs, ordered by the apex f"
